items.item:
8. Restricting a Customer that has a revision, stating none, is refused as
   stale, not as a missing value.
   Shows A04-2. [witness: verification:registry_a04_missing_revision_refused_as_stale]
statements:
for action a on record r in {Project, Customer} that may move r.revision:
  a.stated_revision != r.revision => refused, r unchanged   -- A04-2

statements:

verdicts.why: The selected test detects that restricting a Customer with no stated revision is refused as stale and leaves both the record and audit rows unchanged. It does not establish the invariant universally for every revision-moving action on both Project and Customer records or for all unequal stated revisions.
